title: Adad-Nirari III
summary: King of Assyria; his fifth-year campaign against Damascus and Arpad (806 BC) is on the Tell al-Rimah Stela.
description: King of Assyria, son of Shamshi-Adad V. Griffith & White (Reply to Beckman, Part 2) say he came to the throne as a minor in 811 BC and campaigned against Damascus and Arpad in his fifth year (806/805 BC), naming “Mari of Damascus” and claiming tribute from “Ia-a-su of Samaria”. Person record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman (OSF project 5b64m) on 2026-11-13.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Tier 2, CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 811 BC (accession)). No tier 1–4 birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “The Tell al-Rimah Stela”, p. 15
reign.note: Came to the throne as a minor on the death of Shamshi-Adad V; his fifth year is 806 BC.
